dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Distinct, narrow pale margins along the outer edges of the dark grey folded flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Ovoid reddish-brown patch visible on the posterior dorsal head and neck.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Diffuse but discernible color transition between the reddish-brown nape and the medium-grey mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast white transverse spots on the tail feathers and a small white medial spot on the lower back.
